title: Change in Feo Hospitality Asset Management Pte. Ltd's position in Far East Hospitality Trust
body: Feo Hospitality Asset Management Pte. Ltd executed a transaction for 1,960,881 shares of Far East Hospitality Trust. This increases their holdings from 163,273,992 to 165,234,873 shares.
